task.title: 筛选 All Settings 列表
task.shortdesc: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：筛选 All Settings 列表. Filter by configured, available, Guided-covered, All-Settings-only, invalid, deprecated, raw, or unknown state.

prereq.p: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：筛选 All Settings 列表. Open All Settings with a visible settings list.

context.p: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：筛选 All Settings 列表. State filters narrow a large inventory by the decision the user needs to make. They are different from source filters, which explain where a value came from.

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：筛选 All Settings 列表. Open the list filter toolbar.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：筛选 All Settings 列表. Choose the state filter that matches the task: configured, available, Guided-covered, All-Settings-only, invalid, deprecated, raw, or unknown.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：筛选 All Settings 列表. Inspect the filtered count and representative rows.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：筛选 All Settings 列表. Clear the state filter before applying unrelated edits.

info.note: 警告：保存前请检查架构、值来源以及更改后果。

result.p: All Settings 显示配置文件的预期状态，并且该操作可在审查时解释。 The list shows settings with the selected state only.

postreq.p: 恢复：如果结果不符合预期，请清除筛选器、返回详细信息面板或打开相关主题。 Recovery: if a row is missing, clear state filters and search by exact policy or preference identifier.
